Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1613918. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter by assay CHEMBL1613918, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
